data.narrative:
Kela is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 11 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, comprising 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Singularity.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $100M raised as a proxy for post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A-to-next-stage transitions, implies a valuation of $200M. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company universe yields $1.0B, with the peer set ranging from $125M at the low end to $3.0B at the high end. Sample Series B peers include Dream Security at $3.0B, Allen Control Systems at $2.2B, and Harmattan AI at $1.4B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $170M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $600M. The wide dispersion reflects the heterogeneous risk and revenue profiles within the Defense & Security peer set at this stage. Key uncertainties include the extent to which Kela's technology and market position track toward the upper-quartile peers like Dream Security versus the lower-quartile comparables, and whether the $100M raised reflects true post-money valuation or is best treated as a floor.
